name: designer_vague_incident_escalation
why: An under-specified ask: the assistant must ask the right questions, not guess.
goal: You want a playbook that, when an alert is escalated to Critical severity, creates an incident from it and emails soc-leads@example.com. You only half know what you want at first -- let the assistant ask, and answer its questions.
